info.title: Smart Academic Advisor API
info.description:
REST API for the Smart Academic Advisor platform (Badr University in Assiut, AIDM).

## Authentication
1. `GET /api/auth/csrf` — issues the `csrf_token` cookie and returns the token.
2. `POST /api/auth/login` with `{ email, password }` — returns `accessToken` and sets the `refresh_token` cookie.
3. Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` on every protected request.
4. For every unsafe request (`POST`, `PATCH`, `PUT`, `DELETE`) also send the `x-csrf-token` header equal to the `csrf_token` cookie value.
5. `POST /api/auth/refresh` rotates the refresh cookie and returns a fresh `accessToken`.

### Demo accounts
| Role | Email | Password |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Admin | `admin@bua.edu.eg` | `ChangeMe!2026` |
| Advisor | `advisor1@aidm.bua.edu.eg` | `ChangeMe!2026` |
| Student | `student1@aidm.bua.edu.eg` | `ChangeMe!2026` |

All academic outputs are advisory only (`advisory_only: true`) and never update official grades.
